references.context: Shoot either saucer to lock one ball.
references.label: Lock saucers
references.description: Kickout holes at the upper-left and upper-right corners.

references.context: When Release is lit, shoot the spinner to release the locked ball and start two-ball Multiball.
references.label: Spinner
references.description: The spinner releases the held ball when Release is lit.

references.context: The four upper R-O-C-K lanes spell R-O-C-K.
references.label: R-O-C-K rollovers
references.description: Upper rollover group above the central bumper area.

references.context: Completing a CLUB or RIO bank advances NIGHT MOVES.
references.label: Side target banks
references.description: Target sequences on the left and right sides of the cocktail playfield.

references.context: The right flipper can freeze the moving top 2X lamp.
references.label: Moving top 2X
references.description: Upper-lane multiplier lamp controlled from the right flipper button.
